page.overview:
What is Horse?

The Horse is a large battle-mount (considerably large considering the Yautja and human size difference), it has a glossy smooth head with no discernible eyes, ears, or nose, somewhat similar to a . It has a red body, a tail similar to that of a horse, and hoofed feet.

The original collectible statue that features the Horse was released in Japan by Fewture Models. The model was unpainted and with the Predator rider wielding a gigantic axe. The imported version by Sideshow Collectibles features a completed paint job for the creature and a different weapon for the Predator: a spear with a Yautja head impaled upon it.
